description: Statistics of the app's signed-in players over the last `days`: active, new, visits, retention, money, sources of new players, sales, bookings, and `cost` of recording them. Recorded only while the app setting playerStats is on (off by default, costs quota): check `cost`, then neblla_update_app playerStats: true, live after neblla_promote save. `on: false` = nothing is recorded. More: neblla_get_llms tools/get_stats

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

timeZone.description: IANA zone for booking class times (default UTC).

name: neblla_get_stats
title: Read app statistics
